{{Quote|You come highly recommended by your leader. I am grateful that he agreed to my request for assistance from the Death Watch.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to Hudu Shiv|<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />}}
'''Hudu Shiv''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was regarded as one of their best [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]]. He was sent to work for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] to ensure the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] from the planet [[Kynachi]] before they reached [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and to further the plans of Dooku and his master using [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]]. Shiv performed his assassination, but was unable to flee without being seen by the Jedi, and was forced to fake his own death to ensure Death Watch's anonymity.

==Biography==
Hudu Shiv was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">Events before ''Duel at Shattered Rock'' take place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], according to ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Count Dooku contacted the Death Watch and requested a sniper, and Hudu Shiv was sent. Shiv arrived at [[Dooku's castle (Kohlma)|Dooku's retreat]] on [[Kohlma]], and after being tested with remotes to prove his prowess, he was sent on to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] with specific instructions to assassinate the [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] of [[Kynachi]], [[Langu Sommilor]].<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />

[[File:HuduShiv_vs_Nuru.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Shiv fights against Nuru Kungurama]]
Arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]], where Sommilor was going to meet with an escort, Shiv prepared an ambush outside of [[Vaced Spaceport]], and was hidden under a camouflage net in a tree when [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]], a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] unit [[Breakout Squad]], was on patrol and stumbled upon Shiv's [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] Shiv knocked Breaker unconscious and tied him up, as he had been instructed to not allow anyone to know that a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] had been involved in the assassination.<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />

When Sommilor arrived on Vaced, Shiv used [[Poison dart/Legends|poison darts]] to kill him and the two [[KynachTech Industries]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who accompanied him. Shiv prepared to go, leaving behind the utility belt of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] as Count Dooku had instructed, when Ambase's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] approached him on a stolen [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] with a swoop gang in hot pursuit. Shiv had been instructed to leave Kungurama alive, and attempted to elude them, but knowing the swoops were faster than his speeder bike, tossed a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], knowing Kungurama would be able to avoid it. Kungurama dodged the detonator, but the explosion took out the swoop gang. When Kungurama followed Shiv into the canyon called [[Shattered Rock]], now accompanied by the sole survivor of the gang, [[Gizman]], Shiv circled around to ambush them. Shiv shot Gizz and caused the swoop to crash.<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />

Shiv checked to see if the young Jedi was alive, and found him not only alive but conscious. The two fought a brief duel before the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] Kungurama had been traveling on, arrived. Shiv used his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to flee, and when the ''Hasty Harpy'' followed him, he used his rocket to attack the ship. He returned to his [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] and, after detaching the lifeboat, sent the ship by remote control to follow the Harpy, and let it be destroyed, fooling Breakout Squad into thinking he was dead. The confrontation, though, also resulted in the damaging of the ''Hasty Harpy.'' Then he took the lifeboat to a nearby [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to wait for a Death Watch ship to pick him up, hoping to someday confront Kungurama again.<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Expandsect}}
Dooku commented on Shiv's skill as a Death Watch sniper. Shiv took many precautions but was proud of his abilities and wore a heavily armed set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. Shiv was capable of piloting a variety of vehicles and could use a jetpack.<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hudu Shiv appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2011]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''.
